title: When the Deadline Sings Revisited
author: Oscar Almeida
blurb: Zephyrine Dravenmoor, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
